objective: Independent instrument crosscheck of previously observed relative twilight variability. NOT first-star or model validation.

sources.prior_SG: https://zenodo.org/records/8104891 SG_June_2023.csv; 24 source-indexed optical/IR rows in PR1088; full raw Zenodo MD5 not locally rehashed
sources.unseen_TESS: Native TESS-W stars19_2023-06.dat, UCM/IDA original monthly file with 35-line metadata header
sources.documented_download: https://pypi.org/project/tess-ida-tools/1.1.6/ using tess-ida-get single -n stars19 -m 2023-06; IDA_URL must come from authorized UCM archive
sources.integrity: sha256 original .dat bytes, verify instrument ID, UTC, native 8-field rows and timestamp/position/direction/field-of-view metadata; no third-party substitutes

frozen_sample.match: nearest TESS timestamp within 150 seconds of each exact SG UTC record; all 12 required, one-to-one, reject ties, duplicates, missing and unknown-quality; no replacement nights
frozen_sample.geometry: zenith 90deg, solar depression approx (10.5,16] from source prior position-box ephemeris; outside v1 <=80deg angular acceptance
frozen_sample.atmosphere: real uncontrolled aerosol/cloud/light pollution. No AOD grid, no calibration refit, thermal IR only descriptive

locked_diagnostics: For each of 6 UTC slots flux ratio June18 over June17 is 10^(0.4*(mag17-mag18)), independently per instrument
Sign agreement in six paired slot ratios (greater than 1 means June18 brighter)
June18 03:50 to 03:55 within-device TESS brightness ratio as descriptive secondary check
Raw SHA256, header, matching deltas, skipped inconsistent frequency/MSAS, provenance and any missing/unknown records

predefined_classification.REPLICATED: All 12 valid original TESS records and >=5/6 matching ratio signs: shared relative-change signal replicated only
predefined_classification.DISCORDANT: All 12 valid and <=4/6 matching signs; report disagreement without posthoc change
predefined_classification.INSUFFICIENT: Any absent/ambiguous/invalid 12, saturated/uncalibrated source, unknown time zone or original bytes unavailable; do not impute
predefined_classification.model_v1_first_visibility: ALWAYS UNSUPPORTED and NO acceptance; zenith 90deg, no directional star detection or atmosphere profile

budget_stop: One stars19 June2023 month, <=10MB, 1 read-only parser pass plus synthetic tests; no payment, no simulation; stop if native source/header/date inaccessible or protocol malformed; no rerun for desired outcome
